# LogicSwitch:values

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the test values of the logic switch.

```lua
local values = ls:values([values])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | table of [Source](../../objects/Source/index.md) | optional |  |

## Returns

values (table of [Source](../../objects/Source/index.md))

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
ls = model.getLogicSwitch(0)
ls:values({{category=CATEGORY_TELEMETRY, member=0}, {category=CATEGORY_ANALOG, member=0}})
```
